table_definitions.table_definition: Master data for Letters of Credit, including lifecycle and financial details.
Data related to documentary compliance verification for LCs.
Tracks the lifecycle of trade transactions.
Stores data for SWIFT message integration in trade finance.
Records financial accounting entries for trade transactions.

columns.lc_id: Unique identifier for a Letter of Credit (VARCHAR), column alias as: lc_id
columns.applicant_name: Name of the LC applicant (VARCHAR), column alias as: applicant_name
columns.beneficiary_name: Name of the LC beneficiary (VARCHAR), column alias as: beneficiary_name
columns.issuing_bank_code: SWIFT/BIC code of the issuing bank (VARCHAR), column alias as: issuing_bank_code
columns.lc_amount: Principal amount of the LC (DECIMAL), column alias as: lc_amount
columns.currency_code: ISO 4217 currency code for the LC (VARCHAR), column alias as: currency_code
columns.issue_date: Date when the LC is issued (DATE), column alias as: issue_date
columns.expiry_date: Date when the LC expires (DATE), column alias as: expiry_date
columns.status: Lifecycle status of the LC (ENUM), column alias as: status
columns.goods_description: Description of goods or services covered by the LC (VARCHAR), column alias as: goods_description

columns.lc_id: Linked LC identifier (VARCHAR), column alias as: lc_id
columns.doc_set_id: Unique identifier for a set of documents (VARCHAR), column alias as: doc_set_id
columns.doc_type: Type of submitted document (ENUM), column alias as: doc_type
columns.submission_date: Date when documents are submitted (DATE), column alias as: submission_date
columns.compliance_status: Result of document compliance check (ENUM), column alias as: compliance_status

columns.trans_id: Unique transaction identifier (VARCHAR), column alias as: trans_id
columns.lc_id: Linked LC identifier (VARCHAR), column alias as: lc_id
columns.trans_type: Type of transaction (ENUM), column alias as: trans_type
columns.trans_date: Date when the transaction occurs (DATE), column alias as: trans_date
columns.amount: Monetary value of the transaction (DECIMAL), column alias as: amount

columns.msg_id: Unique SWIFT message identifier (VARCHAR), column alias as: msg_id
columns.msg_type: Type of SWIFT message (ENUM), column alias as: msg_type
columns.sender_bic: SWIFT/BIC of the message sender (VARCHAR), column alias as: sender_bic
columns.receiver_bic: SWIFT/BIC of the message receiver (VARCHAR), column alias as: receiver_bic
columns.lc_id: Linked LC identifier (VARCHAR), column alias as: lc_id

columns.acc_entry_id: Unique accounting entry identifier (VARCHAR), column alias as: acc_entry_id
columns.lc_id: Linked LC identifier (VARCHAR), column alias as: lc_id
columns.entry_date: Date of the accounting entry (DATE), column alias as: entry_date
columns.debit_amount: Debit amount of the accounting entry (DECIMAL), column alias as: debit_amount
columns.credit_amount: Credit amount of the accounting entry (DECIMAL), column alias as: credit_amount
